Segurança - Acronis / Axur / Check Point / Harmony SASE / Qualys / SentinelOne

🚨 Cisco BroadWorks and Openwave Flaws Actively Exploited Despite Available Patches
 
Criticidade: Alta
Ferramenta: Qualys
Fonte: The Hacker News
CVSS: 7.5
Resumo:
Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency (CISA) Tuesday added two security flaws impacting Cisco BroadWorks and Openwave Messaging Webtop Media Transcoder to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities (KEV) catalog, citing evidence of active exploitation. Details of the vulnerabilities are below - CVE-2026-20320 (CVSS score: 7.5) - An improper restriction of XML external entity
Link: https://thehackernews.com/2026/11/cisco-broadworks-and-openwave-flaws.html
 
🚨 Git Patches Flaw That Lets Malicious Repositories Execute Code During Recursive Clones
 
Criticidade: Baixa
Ferramenta: Qualys
Fonte: The Hacker News
CVSS: 2.5
Resumo:
A flaw in Git can let a malicious repository run an attacker's code on a computer that clones it recursively, together with its submodules. The Git project fixed it this week in Git 2.56.1, with matching fixes for the 2.50 through 2.55 series in 2.50.2, 2.51.3, 2.52.1, 2.53.1, 2.54.1 and 2.55.1. The flaw, tracked as CVE-2026-111760, is an integer truncation in how Git handles its index.
Link: https://thehackernews.com/2026/11/git-patches-flaw-that-lets-malicious.html
 
💣 CISA flags Cisco BroadWorks flaw as actively exploited in attacks
 
Criticidade: Alta
Ferramenta: SentinelOne
Fonte: BleepingComputer
CVSS: N/D
Resumo:
The US Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency (CISA) warned on Tuesday that hackers are now exploiting a high-severity Cisco BroadWorks vulnerability in attacks.
Link: https://www.bleepingcomputer.com/news/security/cisa-flags-cisco-broadworks-flaw-as-actively-exploited-in-attacks/
 
💣 SGLang RCE Exploit Breaches NEAR AI, Steals Data From 18 Agents and About 100 Users
 
Criticidade: Alta
Ferramenta: Qualys
Fonte: The Hacker News
CVSS: N/D
Resumo:
An attacker exploited a remote code execution flaw in SGLang, an open-source inference engine, and ran code on one of NEAR AI's inference servers last Sunday. The attacker could also have seen requests being processed on that server that day, including requests sent in confidential mode, the company said earlier this week. That mode processes requests inside a trusted execution environment (TEE
Link: https://thehackernews.com/2026/11/sglang-rce-exploit-breaches-near-ai.html
 
💣 Railway breach leads to $740,000 in fraudulent AI charges
 
Criticidade: Alta
Ferramenta: SentinelOne
Fonte: BleepingComputer
CVSS: N/D
Resumo:
Cloud hosting provider Railway says hackers exploited vulnerabilities in its infrastructure to steal customer authentication secrets and generate approximately $740,000 in fraudulent AI usage, potentially exposing credentials for up to 100,000 workspaces.
Link: https://www.bleepingcomputer.com/news/apple/railway-breach-leads-to-740-000-in-fraudulent-ai-charges/
 
💣 Hackers exploit trusted AWS access to breach multiple cloud environments
 
Criticidade: Alta
Ferramenta: SentinelOne
Fonte: BleepingComputer
CVSS: N/D
Resumo:
A threat actor used compromised identity and access management (IAM) credentials for a Qubole big data platform's AWS account to access and exfiltrate data from multiple customers' AWS environments.
Link: https://www.bleepingcomputer.com/news/security/hackers-exploit-trusted-aws-access-to-breach-multiple-cloud-environments/
